# TiT Online Education Platform

> TiT is a comprehensive online education platform providing live Zoom classes, recorded lessons, and study materials for Sri Lankan Tamil-medium students from Grade 1 to 13.

## Overview
This platform offers students a seamless way to join live classes, access lecture notes, view past papers, and manage their tuition payments. Teachers can manage students, assign materials, and conduct live sessions.

## Key Sections
- [Home](https://titjaffna.lk/)
- [About Us](https://titjaffna.lk/about)
- [Classes](https://titjaffna.lk/classes)
- [Contact](https://titjaffna.lk/contact)
- [Student Registration](https://titjaffna.lk/register)
- [Privacy Policy](https://titjaffna.lk/privacy)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://titjaffna.lk/terms)

## Features
- Secure student & teacher dashboards
- PayHere payment gateway integration
- Automatic Zoom recording fetch and sync
- Comprehensive resource library (Notes, Past Papers, Recordings)
- Multi-language support (English, Tamil, Sinhala)
